title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：machine　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 machine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the engineer ① ran the machine that no worker in the workshop would have tested, and he said the running was the whole of the year. The ② machine, meaning the device itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed untested in the book; a machine, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left untested.

Every ③ machine in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ machine at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A machine, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to test; the engineer said the testing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the machine was the whole of the matter, meaning the power and not the device. The ⑥ machine, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody tests; machine, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a device and a power. He said the power is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ machine had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ machine of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of testing; machine, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to test. He said the testing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ machine I remember is the device tested in the manual, which closed in 1976 and is still tested as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ machine, my mother said in 1978, is the only device that improves by being tested; every machine, she said, is a power that has agreed to look like a device. She said the power was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 机器；机械装置（指车间里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 机器；机械装置（指那台机器本身，与拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：run the machine 开动这台机器
D. n. 机器；机械装置（指留给孩子们装的那一件那一台）
E. n. 机械之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的机器之事）
F. n. 机器；机械装置（指说明书里写到、被测过的的那一台）
G. n. 动力、巧思（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 巧思（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ran the machine that no worker in the workshop would have tested
The machine, meaning the device itself and not the lever
the machine at the far bench
the machine was the whole of the matter
the machine had become a line in a manual
The machine of the whole thing
A machine, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: run the machine 意为“开动这台机器”，1969 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯测试的一台机器做了一遍。
machine 意为“机器；机械装置”，指那台机器本身而不是拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测试。
machine 意为“机器；机械装置”，指车间里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
machine 意为“机器；机械装置”，指最远那张工作台留给孩子们装的那一件那一台，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
machine 意为“动力、巧思”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份动力就是那件事的全部。
machine 意为“巧思”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台机器，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
machine 意为“机器；机械装置”，指说明书里写到、被测过的的那一台，到 1974 年这一台成了说明书里的一行。
machine 意为“机械之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的机器之事是一处车间和三个年头的测试。
machine 意为“机器；机械装置”，我记得的是说明书里测试过的那一台，1976 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一台。
machine 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，机器是唯一会因为被好好测试而变得更好的机器。
